heading: `at <dur>:` grouping and same-stamp order
text:
### `at <dur>:` grouping and same-stamp order [LTSL.3.3]

`at <dur>:`, permitted in `inputs` only, groups the facts that arrive at that
logical time. Source order within a block is the deterministic tie-break for
same-stamp facts, per [LDET.5], and is the only place source order is significant.
